meta.title: A malformed filter on the thread view is a server error

direct.expectedResult: Should be refused cleanly with a 4xx. Today CommonFunctions.parse_filters swallows the JSON error and returns nil, then the thread view reads @filters["thread_id"] on nil (chats_controller.rb:57) → HTTP 500 (an untyped 500 is a defect). Expected: 200 [] ignoring the filter, or 422 code 2.
